description: Use this when you need to find a European Parliament dossier (legislative or non-legislative procedure), an MEP, a committee, a political group or an EP document by name, topic or reference, and you do not know its id yet. Returns up to 15 matching records with their ids and epvotes.com urls; pass an id to get_dossier or get_mep next. Matches words in titles and names (e.g. "digital euro", "Metsola", "ECON", "2023/0212(COD)"). Do not use it for votes of a day; use list_votes.

query.description: Words to match: a dossier title, procedure reference, MEP name, committee code or document number.

type.description: Limit the search to one kind of record.

name: search_parliament
title: Search the Parliament
